dialog.english:
��������Haaaaaah...
I can't take it anymore!
I can't take another step...
We've reached our limit.
Okay, let's take a break!
Hmm...It still doesn't work.

Your computer's not working? If
you give it a whack, it'll be
fine!
Aaah!! P-Please stop!
Tch! I was trying to fix it.
Whew...I hope it isn't broken.

I did it, I fixed it! Huh? Why is
it functioning, even though the
battery's at zero?!

Heeeeey! Everyone, get over here!
There's a factory!

There really is...
but what's a factory doing here?

What's this? Should we
investigate?
Let's check it out!

(This factory...I wonder if it has
anything to do with my computer
working again.)

Heeeeeeey, Koushirou! Let's go
check out the factory!
Yes, I'm coming right now!
It's a really big factory.

If there's a factory, there must
be humans here! Time to
investigate!
Indeed.
This door's closed!

Hnnnnf...! I don't think we're
strong enough to open it.
Please wait a minute.

This kind of door will only open
under certain conditions.
Conditions... What conditions?
Maybe... Something like a switch.

A switch? Like that one right
there?
It definitely looks like a switch.
Hey, Takeru! What's a switch?

When you hit it, there's a "beep"
and something happens!

It’s that kind of thing. So, let’s
go hit the switch.
It worked!

As I thought, the door reacted to
the switch.

So anytime a door doesn't open, we
should look for a switch, right?

It's the power of science! There
must be humans here, no doubt
about it!
Hmmm, it's not opening...

It won't work that way. We should
push the switch.
It isn't opening after all...

Isn't there some kind of spell you
can cast to open a door?
Open, sesame! Like that?
That's so unscientific...
It didn't open.
I'm tired of all these mazes!

Don't panic. Just look for the
switch. Every room seems to be
different...
Hmm, it didn't open.
We might have passed the switch...
Let's keep going for now!

It seems that there's another
door.

There should be another switch
around here somewhere, right?
Let's hurry up and look.
It seems there's another door.
We pressed the switch.
The door should open now, but...
So is it open?

It seems there is also a lock in
which one has to push multiple
switches.
It's not opening?

That's strange. We even pushed the
switch.

Let's keep exploring. I'm sure
we'll find some kind of clue.
We pressed the switch!
The door should probably open.
Another switch?
I think it'll open a door, but...
We pushed the switch, but...
There's no door for it.

Maybe we'll figure it out if we
just keep going.

We've come rather deep into the
factory, but it seems that we
still have a long way to go.
How about we rest here for now?
Where ya goin'?

I'm interested in something, but
it's probably dangerous to stray
too far from the group.
Where ya goin'?

I wanted to take a look at that
passage on the left.
Can you watch TV on that computer?

I don't have a TV tuner, and I
don't know how we'd get a signal.

Then it can't do anything! It's
just an annoyance to the rest of
us.

This place is bigger than I
thought and it's hard to find
anything. My muscles are all sore.

Of course they're sore! We've been
walking all this way.

We got through a jungle, we got
through a desert...

Sora, I'd like to ask everyone
where we should look after this.

Hey, Sora! I see a push cart over
there! Let's play with it!
Hold on, Piyomon! Don't pull me!
(It looks tough for you, Sora...)

Koushirou! It looks like your
computer started working again!
Huh? I wonder why...

Hey, why are you hiding your
computer?
Hahaha...
Waaaaaaait, Patamooooooon!
Ahaha! Okay, you're "it", Takeru!

Those two...I wonder if humans and
Digimon become more alike when
they spend time together?

Why're ya starin' at me,
Koushirou?

Come to think of it...back in
social studies, we took a field
trip to a bread factory.
I went on that trip, too.

We're used to factories with lots
of people working in them, but...

This factory really is full of
mysteries.
We should keep going, but...

There's two doors. Which do we go
through?

This factory is very large. It 
seems more efficient to 
investigate in 2 separate groups.

All right, we'll split into teams.
Koushirou, pick who you want on
yours.
Is it okay for me to choose?

Sure! You're the one who suggested
we split up, after all.
Then...
Go with Yamato, Takeru, and Mimi
Go with Jou and Sora

I will go with Yamato, Mimi, and
Takeru.
Okay, I'll go with Jou and Sora!
I will go with Jou and Sora.
Okay, I'll go with the others!
So it's decided, then.
Okay, we'll meet back up here.
Stay safe, everyone!
Leave this area to me!
Then, let's proceed.
Okay!
Koushirou! Over here!

This room's door has a different
color. Let's take a look!
All right!

It's a large battery and a motor!
Is this what powers the factory?
Wow...
Koushirou!

It's a large battery and a motor!
Is this what powers the factory?
Wow...
Bonding Conversation Test
Bonding Conversation Test
Bonding Conversation Test
Bonding Conversation Test

Huh? There's a door in a place
like this?
Prolly goes inside the battery.
I'll take a look.
Koushirou, we'll come too.

It's okay. Tentomon and I can
investigate on our own.

Okay, we'll wait here for you.
Tell us if you find something.
I will!
Do you want us to come with you?

It's okay. Tentomon and I can
investigate on our own.

We'll wait here, then, so tell us
when you're done.
I will!

Looks like Koushirou and the
others left.
Yeah. We should keep going, too.
Euuuuuugh...
A voice?
It's coming from this room.
Let's check it out.
I'm worried about this.
Over there!
A r-robot?
It's not a robot, it's Andromon!
So this is a Digimon, too?

Yeah, and he's a good Digimon. But
it looks like he can't move.
Really? Then...
He'll move if we give him a whack!
He'll budge if we handle him gently.
Keep watching for a little while.
Don't, Taichi!

No, don't! If you whack him, he'll
break even more!
B-but...

Honestly! Don't you remember how
you almost broke Koushiro's
laptop?
Can't you have a little prudence?
Yes, we should wake him up gently.

But what if he suddenly attacks as
soon as we wake him up?
Why are you worrying so much, Jou?
I have a bad feeling about this.

Yeah! If we're reckless and bang
on him, we don't know what'll
happen!

But how long are we gonna have to
stand around here?
Yeah, but...

Well, we'll keep watching for a
bit more.
Really?

Yeah, nothing's happening. Guess
just watching won't do anything.
Okay, I'm gonna try hitting him!
A-are you serious?
I'm worried about this.

Don't wake him up violently!
You'll scare him.
Anyway, let's wake him up.
Are you sure about this?
It'll be fine. Okay, here goes!

Hey, Taichi! How long are we going
to keep doing this?
Yamato, don't get mad!

Yeah! I mean, I get the feeling of
not wanting to get up in the
morning.

Well, let's just keep watching for
a little longer.
Taichi! Andromon started moving!
...DETECTED!

Oh! He talked! What does he mean
by "detected"?
INTRUDERS DETECTED!
Uwaaaaahh!

Agumon! Didn't you say he was a
good Digimon?!
He's supposed to be!
Guys, ruuuuuun!!
This is...!!

What's this pattern on this side
of the walls?
It's a computer program.
Koushirou, what'cha doing?

I'm trying to analyze this
program. At last, my computer gets
some use...

Koushirou, your face is full'a
life!

It's because I can finally solve
some mysteries. Where we are now,
what you all are, etc.

Huh. I'm not real interested in
that kinda thing.
Really?

Hey Koushirou, is there somethin'
'bout yourself that you're
interested in?

Hey, dear. When are we going to
tell him the truth...?

A little longer. Let's wait a
little longer. If we tell
Koushirou now, it'll shock him.

Hey, Koushirou! Koushirou, over
here!
W-what is it?

There's somethin' weird on ya
computer screen!

The text on the screen is moving
on its own!

The text on the screen is moving
on its own!
Koushirou! The Digivice!
It's lighting up, too!

Atchaaah! Ow ow ow ow ow ow! Hey,
my whole body's burnin' up!

Tentomon! Are you okay?
Maybe it's because of this
program...?

How'd it go? Did you figure
anything out?

Yes! I'll tell you the details
later. For now, let's meet up
again with Taichi.

We were worried! You didn't come
out for a while. Anyway, did you
find anything?

Yes! I'll tell you the details
later. For now, let's meet up
again with Taichi.
Heeeeey! Koushirou, everyone!
Taichi!

Looks like everyone's doing just
fine!

More than fine! I've discovered
something amazing!
What'd you find, Koushirou?

This factory is a program that
generates energy.
So what does that mean?

Things like programs and data in
this world are not just
information.

Digital data also manifests in a
concrete form.
...? That's "something amazing"?

Taichi! If we stay here and chat,
Andromon will catch us!

That's right! Right now, we've
gotta worry about Andromon!
Andromon?

We found a Digimon called Andromon
deep inside the factory, but...
He suddenly attacked us!
Hurry up and get away from here!
Let's go!

Koushirou! Andromon's coming from
that direction!

Is that so? Let's go the other
way.
Darn it, he's chasing us again!
Let's hurry up and run!

T-this is bad! How are we gonna
escape from the roof?

It'll be all right. Let's turn
back for now.
INTRUDERS CAPTURED!
Uh-oh! He caught up to us!
In that case, it's our turn now!
Get back, everyone!
Spiral Sword!
Uwaaaah!
Gwaaah!

His power, speed, everything's a
level above our Digimon!
How are we supposed to win now?
Garurumon, hang in there!
You can do it, Greymon!
Koushirou!

Is it okay if I try the program
from earlier?
Yeah!
All right...
Here it goes!
Whoaaaaa! I feel some kinda power!
Are you all right? Tentomon...!
It worked!
Tentomon evolved?!
Another black gear!
It disappeared!
The evil power is gone...

It seems that he's returned to his
normal self.

I believe this happened because of
the black gear that entered my
body.

Don't worry about it. Guess it was
some kind of error.

As my thanks for helping me, I
will tell you the way out. Leave 
through the underground sewers.
Thanks, Andromon!

I wish you luck, and I hope that
you will be able to return to your
world.

Isn't this the entrance to the
underground sewers?
Of course it is! Okay, let's go!
Hey, what's wrong, Koushirou?!

T-this is...My computer's doing
things by itself!
Uwaah!
W-what's going on?
My body's being pulled away!
Everyone, grab onto something!
It's not working. Whoaaaaa!
Ugh, oof...uhhhhn...ah!
Guys! Where are you?
Taichi!
Agumon! Guys!

Looks like everyone's here, and
doing just fine.
Where are we...?
I don't know.

At the very least, it doesn't look
like we've returned to our world.
They're...!

Digimon! We seem to still be in
the Digimon world after all.

There's something weird about
this...

We're completely lost for the
woods.

I don't wanna be trapped here for
the rest of my life!
Taichi, over there!
A light! Maybe it's our way out!
Let's take a look!
W-we're back...

The sewer entrance! We did it! We
managed to escape!
What was that place, anyway?

It might be a place that comes
from this world's spatial
distortion.

This world really has all kinds of
stuff.

You know, I want to go back there
again sometime.
Huh? Why?

There are Digimon opponents over
there. I think they'll be good for
training!

If we get stronger, we'll be able
to protect you guys!
I'll do my best to protect Sora!
Me too!

I wanna explore that place some
more!

Huh? Someone here's being a bit
trigger-happy.
What about you, Patamon?

I'm a little scared, but if I'm
with you, Takeru, I'll be fine!

Well, anyway, let's get back to
what we were doing and push on!
What Taichi said!

We'll discuss that other place
later.
Okay, let's go!

Sora, I wanna ask everyone about
where we should go after this.

Hey, Sora! I see a push cart over
there! Let's go play with it!
Hold on, Piyomon! Don't pull me!
Help her out
But I wanted to ask you...
Sora, I'll be Piyomon's playmate.

Don't worry about it! I'm the one
she wants to play with.
Really?

But weirdly enough, it's starting
to get kind of cute.
Maybe it's...maternal instinct?

Maternal instinct? Maybe... but
I'm still in elementary school,
you know!
I-I'm sorry!
Haha, I'm joking.

Piyomon seems to be just a little
selfish...

She can't help it, she tends to
get lonely more easily than
others.

But if you keep coddling her like
this, it's only going to get
worse.

Thanks for the concern. But it
hasn't become a huge problem yet,
has it?

Piyomon's very upfront about her
feelings.
Can you watch TV on that computer?

I don't have a TV tuner, and I
don't know how we'd get a signal.

Then it can't do anything! It's
just an annoyance to the rest of
us.
It can use the Internet!
You can use it to view databases.

You can obtain all kinds of
information from all over the
world.
So, can you do that here?
No. I can't do it here, but...
See?
You can view databases with it.
But what good does that do?

I can use the data I have here on
Digimon if there's ever an
emergency.
Huh! That's pretty cool!

I don't really know much about
machines.

This place is bigger than I
thought and it's hard to find
anything. My muscles are all sore.
A bath would warm your muscles.
Me too.

You're right, but...I don't see
anything resembling a bath around
here.
See, of course they would!
We've been walking all this way.

We got through a jungle, we got
through a desert...

We haven't slept in twelve hours.
It'd be great if we could find a
bed somewhere.

Who on earth would make this
factory?
Perhaps Digimon...
Perhaps humans...

It may be Digimon. We have yet to
see any other humans.

That's true. It's pretty unlikely
that any other humans are here.

Looks like we agree on that. I
thought I was the only one who
thought like this.

It must be humans. It's similar to
the factories we're familiar with.

But we haven't seen any humans
like us so far.
That's true, but...

This factory has no one in it,
it's creepy...

You boys seem to like machines.
You don't ever seem to get tired
of it, do you?
I suppose...

But you wouldn't get tired no 
matter how many clothes and 
accessories you looked at, right?
Well, you have a point there!

Koushirou, lemme borrow your
computer! I wanna play with it.
I can't lend this computer to you!
Well, if it's just for a little...
Why...?

People have important things that
they can't let other people
borrow; for me, it's my computer.

For instance, if I asked you to
lend me Patamon, I think you would
refuse, too.

You're right! I wouldn't lend you
Patamon.
Anyway, that's what I mean.
I understand, Koushirou!

Yaaaay! Let me try pushing this!
Boop!

Ah! Please don't do that! Don't be
so reckless!

You don't want to me to have it
after all, do you, Koushirou?

This is precision machinery, so if
you don't handle it carefully, I
can't let you borrow it.
Oh, I see. I'm sorry, Koushirou.

There are a lot of machines here,
but no toys.

To be honest, I'm not sure if it's
a good idea to be splitting up
like this.
Answer confidently
Answer carefully

But with a factory of this size,
it's more efficient to split up.

Koushirou, you're starting to talk
like Taichi. Are you starting to
take after him?
Am I?

That may be true. There's
increased risk when we encounter
enemies.

Ah, I'm sorry! I'm not trying to
blame you!

It's fine, it's a bad habit of
mine to constantly think about
maximizing efficiency.

But sometimes, that's a helpful
way to think.
Thank you, Sora.

I wonder if Taichi and the others
are okay.

Who do you think made this
factory?
Maybe Digimon?
Maybe humans?

It might be Digimon. We haven't
met any other humans.

Really? How would Digimon make
this factory?
Well...

It surely must be humans. It's
very similar to the factories
we're familiar with.

Of course! There should definitely
be humans here!
There's got to be humans here...!

Hm? Aren't Koushirou and the
others checking out that area?

Oops, we're supposed to check out
the other side.
Hm? Are we going this way?

Oh, wait, we're supposed to look
at the right side.
So, what'll we do from here?

Taichi and the others have gone
ahead, so let's head back for now.
